official_definition: True-Drive (When Attacks) You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, at the end of a blocked battle, for each symbol on this Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [True-Drive] or [True-Drive: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [True-Drive]", "give [True-Drive]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Enables direct targeting of opposing Spirit/Ultimate during attack step.
